answer.text:
Creed Bratton is a quirky and somewhat mysterious character at the office. He has a laid-back attitude and often seems to be involved in unusual or shady activities. For example, he once sold Kelly a tapeworm from Mexico, which she believed would help her not gain weight (SCENE 059-060). Creed also talks about having a "close acquaintance" who once backed a truck into the office and cleaned it out, implying some kind of criminal or dubious past (SCENE 068). He is also shown to be somewhat evasive and secretive, as when he says, "Sometimes it's best just to say out of it" (SCENE 018).

Creed is thirty years old (SCENE 029) and has a somewhat playful and defiant attitude toward management, as seen when Michael tries to fire him but Creed insists on fighting it (SCENE 030). He also has a sense of humor and a unique perspective on life, such as when he talks about bankruptcy as "nature's do-over" and compares it to the witness protection program (SCENE 058-061).

Overall, Creed's "deal" is that he is an eccentric, somewhat shady, and unpredictable character who often operates on the fringes of office life, with a mysterious past and a knack for getting into unusual situations.
